example_text.value: Airlines must provide a refund without consumers making a specific request when a consumer’s right to a refund is undisputed. This includes situations when an airline did not offer any alternative transportation or compensation following a flight cancellation, when a consumer rejects the alternative transportation or compensation offered in lieu of a refund, or when a consumer did not respond to the offer of alternative transportation or compensation and the consumer did not take the changed flight or the alternative flight offered.
